portable_contracts.card_status_contract: accepted/rendered/failed/busy render states and stable last_error values are host-facing.
portable_contracts.display_drain_contract: tools/verify_expression_display_drain.py guards one-request-per-pass display drain, target panel refresh, runtime diagnostics before final CardStatusV1, and pending-work reschedule behavior.
portable_contracts.display_generation_hygiene: WBA adapters inherit portable display_queue generation hygiene: active_resource_revision/resource_revision tag every request, comp_epaper_display_queue_set_resource_revision drains or discards stale queued requests, generation_switch_count/stale_generation_discard_count/last_stale_generation_discarded stay observable, and the first WBA ui_assets activation frame must log coherent_generation=1 with generation_switches and last_stale_discarded before visual review.
portable_contracts.display_queue_telemetry: pending_count/high_water_count/dropped_count/next_sequence stats snapshot stays portable and platform-free.
portable_contracts.expression_copy_contract: tools/verify_expression_copy_contract.py guards ExpressionV1 title/body/footer copy across renderer, firmware, catalog, layout, priority, and generated PBM fixtures so WBA target glue cannot fork user-visible text.
portable_contracts.expression_input_source_matrix: tools/verify_expression_input_source_matrix.py guards boot, diagnostic, settings, status, battery, recording, interaction, and OTA input source coverage for WB55 and WBA adapters.
portable_contracts.expression_layout_contract: tools/verify_expression_layout_contract.py guards ExpressionV1 title/body/footer copy against truncation and overlap on supported screen variants.
portable_contracts.expression_priority_matrix: tools/verify_expression_priority_matrix.py guards every current ExpressionV1 face/signal pair, including lower-priority blocking, settings sleepy, battery recovered, duplicate suppression, and transient recovery behavior.
portable_contracts.expression_state_telemetry: comp_epaper_expression_state_snapshot exposes current/last_signal/visible_age_ms/auto_recover_ms/suppressed_duplicate_count stats without target dependencies.
portable_contracts.expression_visual_contract: tools/verify_expression_visual_contract.py guards every ExpressionV1 PBM against blank, overfilled, or visually duplicate faces before target transport changes.
portable_contracts.generated_art_profile_portability: tools/verify_generated_expression_sheet_profile_portability.py proves the same accepted sheet can generate isolated WIDTHxHEIGHT PBM assets with a target-specific suffix, so a WBA panel profile changes CEMP input data instead of recreating the expression engine.
portable_contracts.generated_art_style_contract: tools/render_generated_art_style_contract.py guards genref_sheet_12_inner_faces_v5 style anchors across pet_visual_style.h and MENU_STYLE so WBA ports tune generated-art direction through portable style constants and external CEMP assets instead of target glue or internal Flash bitmaps.
portable_contracts.host_expression_status_sequence: screen_expression_status accepted/final CardStatusV1 pairs keep contiguous refresh_count values, stable request_id/content_crc32, expression CRCs, and diagnostic arg3 decode.
portable_contracts.panel_adapter_telemetry: comp_epaper_panel_adapter_snapshot exposes attempts/rendered/deferred/error/last_result stats without target dependencies.
portable_contracts.pet_attention_policy: pet_attention maps normalized logical touch coordinates to a 3x3 gaze cell and an external attention.* CEMP clip without panel, GPIO, storage, or MCU-family dependencies.
portable_contracts.pet_behavior_user_data_contract: comp_pet_behavior_memory_t is user-data, not ui_assets/CEMP, OTA staging, recording cache, or an MCU Flash constant. WB55/WBA targets must persist it only through a target-owned CRC-protected, wear-aware user-data adapter, preserve it across normal OTA/resource updates, allow factory/privacy erase to clear it explicitly, coalesce writes at low frequency, and keep physical address, erase size, and storage peripheral details out of pet_behavior.h/.c.
portable_contracts.pet_expression_policy: pet_behavior and pet_expression compose ExpressionV1 state, continuous logical gaze, tap and directional-stroke semantics, valence/arousal/curiosity/affection/attachment mood, deterministic personality, low-frequency user-data memory export/import, eyelid openness, eye width, eye spacing, paired-eye tilt, highlight scale, full-face shift, brow, mouth scale, cheek, and mark parameters into the existing screen_framebuffer without panel, GPIO, storage, or MCU-family dependencies; they must not introduce full-screen static expression arrays into internal Flash.
portable_contracts.real_ble_expression_status_sequence: real BLE artifacts must carry the six-face screen_expression_status baseline from companion-screen-expression-host-status-sequence.json before claiming panel parity.
portable_contracts.recording_state_mapper: comp_epaper_expression_signal_from_recording_state maps numeric Recording FSM states into ExpressionV1 signals without depending on WB55 or WBA platform glue.
portable_contracts.runtime_diagnostic_decode: tools/decode_diag_log.py decodes e_paper.runtime_snapshot into decoded_args for host and WBA bring-up logs.
portable_contracts.runtime_diagnostics: e_paper.runtime_snapshot packs expression, display queue, and panel runtime stats from comp_epaper_screen_runtime_snapshot without changing CardStatusV1.
portable_contracts.runtime_diagnostics_bundle: tools/collect_companion_diagnostics.ps1 keeps e_paper.runtime_snapshot in a bounded diagnostics tail with epaper.runtime_snapshot_decoded summary fields.
portable_contracts.screen_runtime_snapshot: comp_epaper_screen_runtime_snapshot aggregates expression, display queue, and panel adapter stats snapshots without target dependencies.
portable_contracts.signal_preflight_api: comp_epaper_expression_signal_is_supported rejects unsupported or future ExpressionV1 signals before visible state, duplicate counters, display queue work, or CardStatusV1 request identity changes.
portable_contracts.target_capability_profile: tools/verify_expression_target_capabilities.py keeps WB55 as the validation target, WBA55 as the shared safe baseline, and WBA65 expansion behind explicit target capability flags without changing common screen limits.
portable_contracts.touch_protocol: FT6336 address/report/identity decoding and gesture recognition stay portable; target I2C and pins stay in target-named adapters.
portable_contracts.wba_adapter_m33_compile_gate: tools/verify_wba_adapter_m33_compile.py compiles every callback-only WBA panel, scheduler, GATT, external-assets, FT6336, power, and pet-memory adapter as strict freestanding Cortex-M33 C for the shared WBA55 baseline without claiming a CubeWBA project or hardware parity.
portable_contracts.wba_cube_dependency_preflight: CubeWBA dependency preflight docs/validation/companion-screen-wba-cube-dependency-preflight.json records whether third_party/STM32CubeWBA exists and keeps WBA status DRAFT_PRE_PORT until a separate CubeWBA project and WBA build wrapper land.
portable_contracts.wba_display_scheduler_scaffold: WBA display scheduler scaffold screen_scheduler_stm32wba.h/.c provides callback-only display task wakeup, expression tick timer, and now_ms boundaries without WB55 UTIL_SEQ/HW_TS details.
portable_contracts.wba_lse_clock_contract: WBA55/WBA65 production boards default to an assembled 32.768 kHz LSE crystal and target-specific load capacitors for BLE sleep timing, RTC continuity, timed wake-up, and low-power behavior; any no-LSE variant requires explicit radio-clock, accuracy, and power evidence.
portable_contracts.wba_panel_target_scaffold: WBA panel target adapter scaffold panel_target_stm32wba.h/.c defaults to dry-run through companion_epaper_panel_stm32wba_init and binds a WBA55/WBA65 target-owned refresh callback through companion_epaper_panel_stm32wba_bind without WB55 pin facts or WB55 build integration.
portable_contracts.wba_refresh_intent_contract: WBA target panel callbacks receive comp_epaper_display_request_t through comp_epaper_panel_refresh_fn_t and must preserve refresh_mode plus dirty_x/dirty_y/dirty_width/dirty_height; WBA55/WBA65 target code maps COMP_EPAPER_REFRESH_PARTIAL_INTERACTIVE, COMP_EPAPER_REFRESH_MAINTENANCE, and COMP_EPAPER_REFRESH_FULL to controller waveforms inside panel_target_stm32wba.* without changing portable queue, scene, or refresh-policy code.
portable_contracts.wba_screen_assets_scaffold: WBA screen-assets scaffold screen_assets_stm32wba.h/.c binds a target-owned logical-partition read callback to comp_asset_store_t as external NOR, checks every read against partition_size, and keeps addresses, storage peripherals, pins, erase, and activation out of portable resource code.
portable_contracts.wba_screen_gatt_scaffold: WBA screen GATT scaffold screen_gatt_stm32wba.h/.c preserves CardWriteV1/CardStatusV1/SettingsV1, settings clear recovery, accepted and final CardStatusV1 identity, settings_sleepy_screen_status, and screen_expression_status without WB55 STM32_WPAN or companion_gatt_stm32wb details.
portable_contracts.wba_touch_target_scaffold: WBA FT6336 touch target scaffold touch_target_stm32wba_ft6336.h/.c binds 7-bit probe/register-read callbacks for WBA55/WBA65 and reuses comp_ft6336_decode_touch_report without CubeWBA HAL or WB55 pin facts.

purpose: Machine-readable pre-port contract for moving the Companion screen expression layer from WB55 to WBA55/WBA65.

targets.rule: Design to WBA55-safe protocol, queue, and memory limits unless a target capability explicitly enables expansion.

wb55_specific_boundaries.panel_backend: WB55 uses companion_epaper_panel_stm32wb_init(); the production bring-up build selects the hardware-proven SSD1681 backend while dry-run remains available for no-panel builds.
wb55_specific_boundaries.panel_target_adapter: panel_target_stm32wb.c is target-named WB55 glue; WBA must add a separate *_stm32wba.* adapter instead of modifying portable screen files.
wb55_specific_boundaries.scheduler: UTIL_SEQ/HW_TS stay in WB55 glue and must not move into portable screen files.
wb55_specific_boundaries.wb55_touch_identity_baseline: address=0x38 cipher=0x64 firmware=0x01 chip=0x11 with zero I2C errors
